spec.title: Add a dispatch status summary endpoint
spec.body:
## Goal
Expose a read-only summary of a dispatch's lines.

## Non-goals
- No UI changes.

## Acceptance
- New endpoint returns 200 with line ids and states.
- Existing dispatch tests still pass.

lines.name: summary_model
lines.task: Add a DispatchSummary builder in src/server/services/dispatch_summary.py that maps a Dispatch to line ids and states

lines.name: summary_route
lines.task: Add GET /dispatch/{id}/summary in src/server/app/dispatch_summary.py using the DispatchSummary builder
acceptance: the route requires the same auth as GET /dispatch/{id}
